description: Ministry of Public Service, Provincial Council and Local Government - 5th Amendment Service minute of the Sri Lanka Scientific Service
categorisation: This gazette content pertains to amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Scientific Service, specifically addressing recruitment procedures, qualifications, age limits, examination schemes, and disciplinary requirements. This falls under public sector administration, specifically public service recruitment and service conditions, which aligns with Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes). The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or fit any other specialized categories (4-7, 9).
